items.title: Pay tax advisor invoice for 2024 income tax return
items.quote: Der Rechnungsbetrag ist ohne Abzug binnen 14 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum fällig.
items.computation: This is a private-law payment deadline (tax advisor invoice), counted under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB from the invoice date. The invoice date (26.05.2025) is the triggering event and is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so the 14-day period starts on 27.05.2025. Counting 14 days: 27,28,29,30,31 May (5), 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 June (9 more) = day 14 is 09.06.2025. 09.06.2025 is a Monday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
